scripts.tag:release: VERSION="$(./scripts/get_tag_version.sh)" && ./scripts/tag_checks.sh release "$VERSION" && npm version --no-git-tag-version "${VERSION#v}" && git tag "$VERSION"
scripts.tag:release:push: VERSION="$(./scripts/get_tag_version.sh)" && ./scripts/tag_checks.sh release "$VERSION" && npm version --no-git-tag-version "${VERSION#v}" && git tag "$VERSION" && ./scripts/tag_checks.sh push "$VERSION" && git push origin "$VERSION"
